i.norm:
Verifies that {@link Md5Crypt#md5Crypt(byte[], Random)} produces a deterministic "$1$" MD5-based crypt hash when the salt is drawn from a seeded, mocked {@link Random}.

Because {@link MockRandom} yields a fixed sequence, the random salt resolves to "........", and hashing the two-byte (all-zero) key yields a reproducible hash string.
